scope: Limited static primary-source corroboration for the expansion NIC descriptor differences. No NAS access, no shared REA session, no firmware execution or patch.
new_observation_supplied_by_root: User reports no router IP via four onboard ports or the expansion10GbE port after the V1500B swap. This reports lack of IP, not PCIe enumeration or physical-link status.
current_machine_fact_supplied_by_root: With R1600, expansion NIC1d6a:04c0 is downstream of00:01.1.

observations.claim: AMD AGESA explicitly documents StartLane greater than EndLane as reversed configuration. The15->8 pair therefore has a documented lane-reversal interpretation, pending confirmation in this BIOS consumer. The8->11 pair describes a forward4-lane range;15->8 spans8 lanes in reverse order.
observations.limit: The public AGESA header is older and has different field widths. It corroborates semantics; it does not independently prove the layout/behavior of the Synology-specific DXIO consumer.

observations.claim: The public AMD Picasso DXIO header maps logical8..15 to GFX0..7 and warns that logical lane IDs are not physical lane numbers. It supports x8 or split x4 GFX configurations.
observations.limit: Physical board connectivity and the exact V1500B mapping still require board evidence or its actual lane-mapping consumer.

observations.claim: Using the public FSP port bitfield layout, both descriptors decode to enabled device1/function1. The normal word0xf0002101 yields clk_req15, ASPM disabled, L1.1/L1.2 off. The alternative0x4e002101 yields clk_req4, ASPM L1, L1.1/L1.2 on. The public enum names4 as CLK_REQ3; CLK_ENABLE is0xff, which narrows to0xf in the4-bit field.
observations.limit: The values fit the known BDF, but reuse of this exact bitfield layout by this BIOS is an inference until its consumer is checked. A changed request selector does not by itself prove clock loss.

observations.claim: AMD AGESA describes ResetId as a platform-assigned identifier for a reset-control GPIO; ports sharing a reset GPIO share the identifier. Therefore35 versus4 cannot be read directly as physical GPIO35 versusGPIO4.
observations.limit: Mapping of the target descriptor field through the DS1522 reset callback/table remains to be established.

observations.claim: AMD documents a concrete PCIe implementation where a reversed x8 link downshifted to x4 can leave the partner lane0 unconnected and fail training. This shows why width negotiation does not universally cure a reversal/topology mismatch.
observations.limit: This is NOT a Raven/V1500B specification. It supports only the general mechanism and must not be used to assert that V1500B cannot negotiate this configuration.

conditional_mechanism: If this BIOS interprets15->8 as a reversed8-lane port and the DS1522 connector only carries the lanes used by the working8->11 setup, the effective lane0/active-lane subset could be different. A link may then fail even though the root-port BDF remains01.1. Whether automatic reversal/downtraining remaps it successfully depends on this controller, the endpoint and actual wiring; none was observed with V1500B.
clock_reset_boundary: The clock-request, ASPM and reset/group settings differ as well. They warrant checking the existing board-specific clock/reset mapping, but do not establish a clock/reset failure without that mapping and the failed boot state.
priority: Secondary unresolved point. The other agent is checking the no-disk/recovery environment for atlantic driver availability. A NIC with no driver/DHCP can have a functioning PCIe link, so the report of no IP cannot distinguish these cases.
not_established: Actual physical routing of the expansion connector.
Whether V1500B selected the alternative table in the failed boot.
Whether00:01.1 existed, its negotiated width, or whether endpoint1d6a:04c0 enumerated.
Meaning of reset/group4 versus35 on this board.
Whether alternative clock settings disabled or misrouted the actual expansion clock.
required_discriminating_observation: When a V1500B boot can eventually be observed, the presence of the expansion endpoint and its PCIe link state distinguishes a hardware/topology issue from the independent missing-driver/network-configuration path.
cleanup: Only this evidence JSON and a short upstream AGESA excerpt retained. No downloaded full header, firmware derivative, or temporary program created.
